current_role: Host of The Tucker Carlson Show and co-founder of the Tucker Carlson Network (since 2023)
summary: Tucker Carlson is a conservative commentator who co-hosted CNN's Crossfire, hosted shows on MSNBC, and from 2016 to 2023 hosted Tucker Carlson Tonight, Fox News's top-rated show, until Fox dropped him. He co-founded the Daily Caller in 2010 and launched his own network in 2023. A leading Trump backer who helped push JD Vance onto the 2024 ticket and connected Trump with Robert F. Kennedy Jr., he broke with Trump over the Iran war in 2025–2026 and said Trump should be removed from office.
